summary: Maplewood Community Theater, founded in autumn 1992, is launching workshops and training programs from September 5th, 2023 for children, teens, adults, backstage trainees, and underrepresented participants. Each program is led by a named director or specialist and ends with a community showcase on the theater's stage. The note stresses nurturing local talent, lifelong participation, and inclusivity.
one_line: Maplewood Community Theater offers age-specific, technical, and inclusive workshops starting September 2023, each ending in a community showcase.
key_facts: Maplewood Community Theater was set up in the autumn of 1992 and is known for welcoming individuals from all walks of life.
The theater's series of workshops and training programs is slated to commence on September 5th, 2023.
"Tiny Steps on Stage" is for children aged 5 to 7 and is guided by children's director Susan O'Neill, who has over 15 years of experience in children's theater.
"The Young Performers' Ensemble" is for ages 8 to 12 and trains in voice modulation, basic stage movements, and character development.
The "Teen Thespian Initiative" starts October 14th, 2023 for ages 13 to 17 and is led by Mark Davidson, who has Broadway experience.
Teen participants engage in intensive scene work, improvisational theater, and ensemble learning.
"Stagecraft for Adults" is for those over 18, starts November 1st, 2023, and covers acting, set design, lighting, and sound management under director Emma Thomson.

The "Behind-the-Scenes" training series, led by technical director Jason Clark, launches September 25th, 2023 and covers stage management, lighting, costume, and set design with hands-on use of the theater's equipment.
"All Voices on Stage" starts September 15th, 2023 and provides a platform for underrepresented voices and people with different abilities.
Angela Hart, an inclusion advocate and director, guides "All Voices on Stage" and says, "Theater is for everyone."
Susan O'Neill says the children's program is "not about creating child stars but about instilling confidence and the love of arts at an early age."
At the end of each workshop and training session, participants perform in a showcase for friends, family, and neighbors at the theater.
